journey_rules: This is an SPA — ONLY use action 'click' on visible elements. NEVER type URLs directly or use 'navigate' action.
NEVER navigate to /landing-screen or any pre-login URL — it will log you out.
After reaching the dashboard, click each main nav item one by one: Dashboard, Transact, Our Schemes, Knowledge Centre, Support.
Under Transact, explore Purchase, SIP, Redemption, Switch sub-sections.
Click the Business and Investor tabs on the dashboard.
Explore all sub-menus, tabs, and expandable sections.
If you see dropdown menus, hover/click to reveal sub-items.
Do NOT click logout or sign out.
Do NOT submit any actual transactions — only explore the forms.
IMPORTANT: Any direct URL navigation will land on a blank white page and log you out. Only click visible elements.
